answer.new_information: NN, Inc. announced in late June 2026 that it would add 47 machine centers at its Wuxi, China plant for liquid cooling production for NVIDIA AI data center racks, with 100% of the new capacity said to be pre-sold under multi-year, multi-product awards. The US$80-90 million 2026 accretive new business figure is NN's own target, not a result. The original_day is blank in the record, so the announcement date is only given as late June 2026. No capex, customer name, or NVIDIA confirmation of the awards is given. The Russell Microcap Value Index removal and the narrative revenue and earnings projections to 2028 are outside the NVDA research scope or are third-party projections, and the unnamed-analyst estimate is a rumour. None of these matches a stored or catalog NVDA question.
